events.verdict: Embiid (PHI) makes marginal contact with DeRozan's (SAS) body and cleanly blocks his shot attempt.
Chandler (PHI) briefly grasps Aldridge's (SAS) arm, but does not affect his ability to grab the rebound.
Simmons (PHI) makes marginal contact with DeRozan (SAS) and does not extend his arm into him to clear space.
[Observable in enhanced video] Simmons (PHI) takes more than two steps after his gather.
Coach Brown (PHI) steps on to the floor during play.
Redick (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in Gay's (SAS) path and does not deliver the contact.
Gay (SAS) moves A to B into Redick's (PHI) body and affects his ability to land safely following his jump shot attempt.
Aldridge (SAS) and Embiid (PHI) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
DeRozan (SAS) establishes himself in a screening position in Simmons's (PHI) path and he switches onto him.
Chandler (PHI) wraps Gay (SAS) around the waist and affects his ability to get to the pass.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Gay (SAS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Redick (PHI) and Gay (SAS) briefly engage and disengage following the screen.
Aldridge (SAS) maintains a legal guarding position on Embiid's (PHI) drive to the basket.
LAR shows Embiid (PHI) does not extend his arm into Aldridge (SAS) to clear space at the end of his drive to the basket.
White (SAS) makes marginal contact with Embiid's (PHI) body and cleanly blocks his shot attempt at the basket.
Correctly called 24 second violation.
Chandler (PHI) makes marginal contact with DeRozan (SAS) that does not affect his driving shot attempt and he cleanly blocks the shot.

DeRozan (SAS) makes slight contact with Chandler's (PHI) head/neck area during his driving shot attempt, but the contact occurs as a result of DeRozan naturally protecting his shot. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
DeRozan (SAS) commits a take foul on Brewer (PHI).
Belinelli (SAS) and Brewer (PHI) engage and disengage during the inbound.
Simmons (PHI) and Belinelli (SAS) engage and disengage during the inbound.
Aldridge (SAS) establishes himself in a screening position in Simmons's (PHI) path and does not deliver the contact.
Simmons (PHI) cleanly deflects the ball away from Belinelli (SAS) and the contact to the body following the deflection is incidental.
